knowledge_point.title: Multiplying a Matrix by the Identity Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Calculate the product ${I}_{2}B$ given that ${I}_{2}$ is the $2\times 2$ identity matrix and
$B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Any matrix, when multiplied by an identity matrix, remains unchanged (assuming that the multiplication is well defined).

The matrix ${I}_{2}$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix and $B$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix too. 

Therefore, the multiplication is well defined and 

$$
{I}_{2}\cdot B=B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}.
$$
